title: 第九章 铁血手段第十章 死神印
content_zh:
第九章：铁血手段苏命面露冷笑，手上悄然用力。
“喀嚓！”
只听得一声脆响，下一刻刘福的脸色瞬间变得扭曲起来。
“啊！”
他发出一声痛苦的哀嚎，整个人因断手之痛而冷汗直冒，颤抖不已。
“柳公子救我！”这种时候，他也只能向一旁的柳如龙求救。
“真是没想到，你居然隐藏了实力！”一旁，柳如龙松开怀中的女子，见此情形的女子们瞬间作鸟兽散。
起身，柳如龙上下打量了苏命一番，啧啧叹道：“气海境一层，居然就有了压制气海境五层的实力，看起来你并非之前我见过那般不堪。说，你伪装到现在目的是什么？”
这些年来，因为苏家和柳家的关系，他们时不时就会见面。但每一次见面，柳如龙印象里的苏命都是一副要死不活，弱不禁风的样子。
可这一转眼，苏命不仅生龙活虎，居然还有了现在这般手段，这不由让他感到极为诧异。
他起身来到苏命跟前，脸上肥肉颤动道：
“你该不会以为这样，你就可以继承苏家家业，成为苏家家主吧？”
“我告诉你，苏家的继承人，只能是我表哥苏权，至于你，不过是一个路边捡来的杂种。”
“哪怕是现在不知道用什么办法强行将境界提升到气海境一层，你……也还是个垃圾。”
听到杂种这个词，苏命的双眸之中瞬间迸发出愤怒的火焰。
苏命从小就失去了母亲，因此他一直都无比渴望得到母爱，也曾在脑海中想象过无数次自己母亲的模样。
从小到大，母亲这个词都是苏命最大的禁忌。
柳如龙骂他是杂种，那绝对是不可饶恕的罪行！
“你该死！”苏命恶狠狠开口，声音如低沉咆哮的恶狼。
“哈哈哈哈！”柳如龙闻言哈哈大笑起来：“苏命啊苏命，你是不是以为压制了气海境五层的刘福，就真的以为你自己无敌了啊？”

“我告诉你，我可是货真价实的气海境七层。”
“你的那点手段在我面前就跟笑话一样。现在你要是在我面前乖乖磕几个响头，我还可以给你一个痛快。否则，我不介意重新将你打为一个废人。让你一辈子都背着废物的名头，生不如死地活下去。”
一旁的刘福也在狞笑：“苏命，你还不放开我？以我和柳公子的关系，我还可以给你求求情呢。”
苏命死死遏制着体内涌动的怒火：“我还有最后一个问题，派去杀我的张三，是你们谁的意思。”
“张三？”柳如龙装模作样地思索了一下：“诶，那不是早些年安排去苏家的吗？”
刘福急忙点头：“柳公子您都忘了，您让我把张三安插进去之后就忘了，还是前些日子您喝醉酒了才让我给张三下令……”
后面的话刘福没说，但屋内的三人都心照不宣。
“哦，我想起来了。”柳如龙恍然大悟：“原本我是打算替表哥一劳永逸处理掉这个废物的，都怪他太没存在感。让我几年都没想起来，不过……现在也不晚。”
说着，柳如龙悄然关上了房门。
大有一副关门打狗的架势。
“好，很好！”苏命轻轻点头，这样一来，一切就都清楚了。
苏家要杀自己的是柳媚儿。
而指使众妙楼对自己动手的，是柳如龙！
“砰！”
苏命一拳轰在刘福胸口，一声闷哼响起，巨大的力量让刘福一弓，前胸和大腿瞬间贴合在一起。整个人瞪大眼睛倒飞出去，重重摔在地上，生死不知。
看着跌落在一旁的刘福，柳如龙没有半点同情，反而不屑道：“什么档次，还想跟我沾边？落到这种下场也是活该。”
说着，柳如龙转头看着苏命道：
“哼哼！让你多活了这么久，你也该去死了！苏命，下辈子记得投个好胎。”
content_en:
Chapter 9: Iron-Blooded Means Su Ming sneered and quietly exerted force on his hands.
"Crack!"
There was only a crisp sound, and the next moment Liu Fu's expression became distorted.
"Ah!"
He let out a painful cry, and his whole body was sweating and trembling from the pain of his broken hand.
"Master Liu, help me!" At this time, he could only ask Liu Rulong for help.
"I didn't expect that you actually hid your strength!" On the side, Liu Rulong let go of the woman in his arms, and the women who saw this situation instantly dispersed.
After getting up, Liu Rulong looked Su Ming up and down, and sighed: "At the first level of the Qi Sea Realm, you actually have the strength to suppress the fifth level of the Qi Sea Realm. You don't look as unbearable as I have seen before. Tell me, what is the purpose of you pretending to be so far?"
Over the years, because of the relationship between the Su family and the Liu family, they would meet from time to time. But every time they met, Liu Rulong's impression of Su Ming was that he was desperate and weak.
But in the blink of an eye, Su Ming was not only full of energy, but also capable of the methods he had now, which made him extremely surprised.
He stood up and came to Su Ming, the fat on his face trembled and said:
"You don't think that you can inherit the Su family's business and become the head of the Su family, right?"
"I tell you, the heir to the Su family can only be my cousin Su Quan. As for you, you are just a bastard picked up on the roadside."
"Even if you don't know how to forcibly raise your realm to the first level of Qi Sea Realm now, you... are still trash."
Upon hearing the word bastard, Su Ming's eyes instantly burst into angry flames.
Su Ming lost his mother when he was a child, so he has always longed for maternal love, and he has imagined his mother's appearance in his mind countless times.
Ever since he was a child, the word mother has been Su Ming's biggest taboo.
Liu Rulong called him a bastard, which was definitely an unforgivable crime!
"You deserve to die!" Su Ming said viciously, his voice like a low and roaring wolf.
"Hahahaha!" Liu Rulong burst out laughing when he heard this: "Su Ming, Su Ming, do you think you are invincible because you suppressed Liu Fu, who is at the fifth level of the Qi Sea Realm?"
"Let me tell you, I am truly at the seventh level of the Qi Sea Realm."
"Your little tricks are like a joke in front of me. Now if you kowtow a few times in front of me, I can give you a good time. Otherwise, I don't mind beating you up as a useless person again. Let you carry the name of useless person for the rest of your life, and live in a life worse than death."
Liu Fu on the side was also smiling ferociously: "Su Ming, why don't you let me go? With my relationship with Mr. Liu, I can still beg you for mercy."
Su Ming tightly controlled the anger surging in his body: "I have one last question. Which of you did Zhang San who was sent to kill me do it?"
"Zhang San?" Liu Rulong pretended to think for a moment: "Hey, wasn't it arranged to go to the Su family a few years ago?"
Liu Fu nodded hurriedly: "Young Master Liu, you forgot. You asked me to insert Zhang San and then you forgot. You were drunk a few days ago and you asked me to give Zhang San the order..."
Liu Fu didn't say the next words, but the three people in the room all understood it tacitly.
"Oh, I remembered it." Liu Rulong suddenly realized: "Originally, I planned to deal with this waste once and for all for my cousin, but it was because he had no sense of existence. I didn't think of it for several years, but... it's not too late now."
With that said, Liu Rulong quietly closed the door.
There is a posture of closing the door and beating the dog.
"Okay, very good!" Su Ming nodded lightly, and everything became clear.
The person in the Su family who wanted to kill him was Liu Meier.
And the one who instigated Zhongmiaolou to attack him was Liu Rulong!
"Bang!"
Su Ming punched Liu Fu in the chest, and a muffled groan sounded. The huge force caused Liu Fu to bow, and his chest and thighs instantly connected together. Everyone staredThe big eyes flew out and fell heavily to the ground, not knowing whether he was alive or dead.
Looking at Liu Fu who fell aside, Liu Rulong didn't have the slightest sympathy. Instead, he said disdainfully: "What kind of person do you want to be with me? You deserve to end up like this."
After saying that, Liu Rulong turned to look at Su Ming and said:
"Humph! I've allowed you to live for so long, you should die! Su Ming, remember to give birth to a good child in your next life."
